Data contracts are the new SLA, the argument in one line. Expectations testing catches silent nulls before they become model incidents.
Column-level lineage answers regulator questions in hours.
Consolidation of duplicate pipelines is the fastest cost win in most estates.

data contracts are the new SLA fails, when it fails, in one specific place: deferral: lineage and contracts scheduled for phase two, which arrives after the first regulator question does. By then every metric is a negotiation.

Against data contracts are the new SLA, the strongest counter-case is worth naming: the spine-first thesis can become a two-year plumbing project nobody ships against. The spine is earned slice by slice, each one attached to a live decision.
The practice, as we run it

In delivery, data contracts are the new SLA becomes a specific discipline: the work is pipeline and lakehouse engineering, modeled once, certified once, reused everywhere the decision appears. Every program in the Data & Lakehouse domain carries the same obligations, a signed baseline, named gate criteria, and evidence generated by running the system rather than preparing for a meeting.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: data contracts are the new SLA, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
